description: Sud-Ouest : Canalisations TMD - TIGF - Région TIGF (surfacique) is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Access to data is restricted to authorised persons. This dataset contains the boundaries of TIGF regions, related to the transmission lines of natural gas or similar gas, hydrocarbons and chemicals of the TIGF carrier. The data is provided by the TIGF carrier. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "South-West: TDG Pipeline — TIGF — Region TIGF (surface)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
